fusions.name: Quick Fang
fusions.desc: Strikes the first enemy it meets for 4 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Settled
fusions.desc: Falls on a target at or below 30% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 16 damage.

fusions.name: Lunging Glide
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. For 4 seconds after, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Coiled Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
